one_line: Resignations over Pentagon AI contract, Google AI search changes, India seeks debt for data centres, OpenAI claim mocked

themes.title: DeepMind researchers resign over Pentagon contract
themes.text: Two DeepMind researchers left Google citing insufficient oversight of the Pentagon AI contract.

stories.headline: Two Google DeepMind researchers resign over Pentagon AI contract, oversight concerns

themes.title: Google AI search cuts publisher traffic
themes.text: Google’s AI Overviews shift search to AI summaries, reducing traffic to news sites and paying minimal fees to publishers.

stories.headline: Google’s AI search overhaul reduces traffic and pays tiny fees to publishers

themes.title: India AI sector looks to debt financing
themes.text: India’s AI industry plans to use debt to build data centres amid GPU obsolescence and regulatory risks.

stories.headline: India's AI sector looks to debt financing for data centres amid GPU and regulatory risks

themes.title: OpenAI researcher mocked over air‑gapped claim
themes.text: An OpenAI researcher was mocked after suggesting air‑gapped AIs could communicate via CPU temperature changes.

stories.headline: OpenAI researcher mocked for claim air‑gapped AIs could communicate via CPU temperature
